{{Season Infobox |background=AAF |cellcolor=FCC |name=Pokémon: DP Sinnoh League Victors |image=Season 13 Logo.png |caption=Logo for the season |number=13 |opening=We Will Carry On! |numeps=34 |region=[[Sinnoh]] |series=''[[Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl]]'' |prev=Pokémon: DP Galactic Battles |next=Pokémon: Black & White }} '''Pokémon: DP Sinnoh League Victors''' is the thirteenth [[season]] of the [[dub]]bed version of the [[Pokémon animated series]]. It is the fourth and final season of ''[[Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl]]''. It follows {{Ash}} and {{an|Dawn}} as they conclude their journey in the [[Sinnoh]] [[region]]. It began on June 5, 2010 with the dub premiere ''[[DP158|Regaining the Home Advantage!]]'', and concluded on February 5, 2011 with ''[[DP191|Memories Are Made of Bliss!]]''. It originally aired in {{pmin|the United States}} as part of the 2010-2011 {{wp|Cartoon Network}} Saturday morning lineup. It is preceded by [[S12|Pokémon: DP Galactic Battles]] and succeeded by [[S14|Pokémon: Black & White]], the first season of the dub of ''[[Pokémon the Series: Black & White]]'', which is based on the [[Generation V]] {{pkmn|games}}. ==Blurb== ''Watch Ash, Dawn, and Brock travel across the Sinnoh region to face challenges, battles, and the antics of Team Rocket! With Team Galactic out of the way, Ash can now focus on qualifying for the Sinnoh League. And Dawn will train to compete for her final Contest Ribbon, which would allow her to compete in the Grand Festival!'' ==Important events== {{spoilers}} * [[Ash's Buizel]] learns {{m|Ice Punch}}. ([[DP159]]) * {{Ash}} competes in the [[Pokéathlon]]. ([[DP160]]) * {{an|Dawn}} meets up with [[Ursula]] and enters the [[Daybreak Town]] Contest, winning her fifth and final [[Ribbon]], completing her requirement for the Sinnoh Grand Festival. ([[DP161]] - [[DP162]]) * {{an|Barry}} returns, revealing that he now has eight [[Badge]]s, qualifying him for the [[Sinnoh League]]. ([[DP163]]) * The location of the Sinnoh Grand Festival is revealed to be [[Lake Valor]]. ([[DP163]]) * [[Dawn's Piplup]] learns {{m|Hydro Pump}}. ([[DP164]]) * Ash and his friends meet [[Volkner]], the [[Sunyshore City]] [[Gym Leader]] and [[Sinnoh]] [[Elite Four]] member [[Flint]]. Ash has a battle with Flint, inspiring Volkner to battle challengers again. ([[DP165]]) * Ash's Sunyshore [[Gym]] battle is postponed. ([[DP166]]) * Ash's newly evolved {{AP|Torterra}} learns {{m|Leaf Storm}}. ([[DP166]]) * {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} meet [[Marley]] and help her rescue a {{p|Shaymin}}. ([[DP168]]) * Ash and his friends meet {{ra|Ben}}, a {{OBP|Pokémon Ranger|Ranger series}}, and aid him in a mission involving {{p|Heatran}}. ([[DP169]]) * Ash and his friends meet Sinnoh Elite Four member [[Bertha]]. Ash has a {{pkmn|battle}} against Bertha, but loses. ([[DP170]]) * [[Jessie]] participates in the [[Arrowroot Town]] {{pkmn|Contest}} and loses to [[Princess Salvia]] but is given the Ribbon by the latter, thereby completing her requirement for the Sinnoh Grand Festival. ([[DP171]]) * Ash and his friends arrive at [[Valor Lakefront]] for the Sinnoh Grand Festival. ([[DP173]]) * The [[Sinnoh Grand Festival]] takes place. ([[DP174]] - [[DP177]]) ** Dawn, [[Zoey]], [[Nando]], Jessie, and Ursula make it to the [[Contest Battle|Battle Stage]], while {{si|Kenny}} loses in the [[Appeal|Performance Stage]]. ([[DP174]]) ** Dawn battles Ursula and wins, putting her in the Top 16. Jessie, Nando, and Zoey also make it to the Top 16. ([[DP175]]) ** Dawn, Zoey, Jessie, and Nando make it to the semifinals. Zoey battles Nando and wins, while Dawn defeats Jessie. ([[DP176]]) ** Dawn and Zoey face off in the finals and Zoey wins, receiving the [[Ribbon Cup]] and becoming a [[Top Coordinator]]. ([[DP177]]) * Ash and his friends meet [[Buck]]. ([[DP181]]) * The [[Lily of the Valley Conference]] takes place. ([[DP182]] - [[DP189]]) ** Ash looks over {{cat|Ash's Pokémon|his Pokémon}} at [[Professor Oak's Laboratory]]. ([[DP182]]) ** The opening ceremonies mark the beginning of the tournament, with 64 competitors present. ([[DP182]]) ** Ash battles Nando in the first round and wins. ([[DP183]]) ** [[Paul]] battles Barry in the third round and wins. ([[DP184]]) ** Ash battles [[Conway]] in the third round and wins. Ash and Paul are paired to battle in the fourth round. ([[DP185]]) ** Ash has a [[Full Battle]] with Paul in the fourth round and wins. The two settle their differences and end their [[rival]]ry. ([[DP186]] - [[DP188]]) ** Ash battles {{si|Tobias}} in the semifinals and loses. Ash places Top 4 while Tobias goes on to win the Lily of the Valley Conference. ([[DP189]]) * Ash and {{an|Brock}} return to [[Kanto]] while Dawn stays in Sinnoh.
